Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate qualification — request for additional information (SUP-01)

Dear Frost Technotics team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for part SI-CP-0007 (NPI liquid-cooling cold plate, rev A, drawing SI-DWG-CP-0007). To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 2.pfmea — Your current process FMEA (PFMEA) for this part.
2. 4.burst_pressure — A burst / proof pressure test report showing sustained proof pressure of at least 3× the 6 bar maximum operating pressure for a hold of at least 60 s with no rupture, per Stark's requirement sheet.
3. 6.lead_time — Your quoted lead time for this part (Stark's need-by lead time is 12 weeks).
4. 8.flowdown — Evidence that Stark's requirements are flowed down to your critical sub-tier supplier (Wakanda Design Group), e.g. purchase-order clauses or a quality agreement.

Please cite the document and section for each item in your reply.

Regards,
Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: No burst/proof report in reliability_report.md: witness or review raw data for a proof test at ≥ 18 bar (3 × 6 bar MOP) held ≥ 60 s with no rupture, including test rig calibration and sample traceability.

No PFMEA in the packet: review the PFMEA for SI-CP-0007 on site, confirm it is current to rev A and covers base thickness, port bore and mounting-hole pitch, and that its controls match the control plan (quality_manual.md §9.2).

No quoted lead time in the packet: review the quoting basis, material lead times and scheduling to confirm whether the supplier can deliver within Stark's 12-week need-by, given 2741 parts/week demonstrated (capacity.md §1.1).
